chose: A note the owner marked fast that the queue's model has not tried yet is FastTrack: it is first among the least-tried, so at the head of the line, and the transcriber's pass does not give the lane its turn before it, for that one try. Once tried it is Wanted, behind every note tried fewer times, so TR1 (C895) holds literally; after a model bump, a marked note no model has heard is FastTrack again under the new model. The contention guard's excused note still gives way. The give's exception is one deadline per marked note per model within one run of file_host: the guard's streak is kept in memory, so a restart during an excused FastTrack try can grant it one more.
